persons.name: Jayamaṅgala
persons.evidence: yasya khyāti(!) tridhā loke kṛte(!) yatnena pañjikā

date.as_written: samvat tra hṛ e caitrakṛṇa 3 aṃgāravāsare

notes: The year is expressed in letter-numerals (akṣarapallī): tra hṛ e = 651. The verse identifies the commentator as known by three names: Jayeśvara, Jayadeva, and Jayamaṅgala.
